parsed.notes:
Reinforcement learning is required because its unmarked experience-list mention overrides the later optional mention; its independent optional mention also removes it from the initial alternative group. Machine learning is independently required, leaving no retained group from that list.
The programming languages form the sole retained alternative group.
Read ML training as model development; this wording would need an alias added to the taxonomy.
Read the requested background in machine learning and data science as candidate expertise in named taxonomy skills, not as a degree requirement. Computer science, mathematics, and physics are excluded as academic/domain knowledge.
Product engineering, AI-related technical consulting, and problem decomposition are explicit candidate asks without sufficiently exact taxonomy entries.
Seniority follows a literal reading of leading technical discovery as a lead duty; flagged because this could instead mean facilitating discovery, in which case the explicit three-year minimum supports mid.
